data.name: Godius Eternal War
data.detailed_description:
Enter the world of Godius, a classic 2D pixel MMORPG that has continued its legacy since 1999.

Choose your nation, build your character, forge alliances, and fight for dominance in a persistent online world driven by players, war, economy, and community.

Godius brings back the spirit of old-school MMORPGs where every adventure mattered, every item had value, and every player could become part of the world's history.

Classic MMORPG Experience

Experience the charm of retro 2D pixel graphics combined with deep multiplayer gameplay inspired by the golden age of online RPGs.

Explore dangerous fields, hidden dungeons, towns filled with players, and a living world where cooperation and rivalry coexist.

Nation Warfare & Player Competition

Join one of multiple nations and participate in large-scale nation wars.

Fight against enemy players in open PvP zones, defend your allies, and compete for power, honor, and territory.

Player-Driven Economy

Trade equipment, materials, and rare items with other players through a community-driven economy.

Hunt powerful monsters, gather resources, craft equipment, and build your own path to wealth and strength.

Party Play & Community

Adventure together with friends and guild members in a world designed around social interaction.

From hunting parties to guild wars, Godius rewards teamwork, communication, and long-term community building.

A Living Legacy Since 1999

Originally launched in 1999, Godius returns with the authentic spirit of classic online RPGs loved by longtime MMORPG fans.

Whether you are a veteran seeking nostalgia or a new adventurer discovering retro MMORPG gameplay for the first time, the world of Godius awaits you.

Features

  • Classic 2D Pixel MMORPG

  • Persistent Online World

  • Nation Warfare System

  • Open PvP & Guild Battles

  • Community-Driven Economy

  • Party-Based Hunting

  • Retro Old-School MMORPG Experience

  • Large Multiplayer World

  • Character Progression & Equipment Collection

  • Cooperative & Competitive Gameplay

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 또는 AMD 동급 2Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 capable GPU, Feature Level 10.0+, 512 MB VRAM (Intel HD 4000 / GT 730 class)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows 호환 사운드 장치
  • Additional Notes: Steam 클라이언트 실행 및 온라인 접속이 필요합니다.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 또는 동급 4Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForece GTX 750 / AMD Randeon HD 7750 / Intel UHD Graphics 620 이상. VRAM 1GB이상
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows 호환 사운드 장치
  • Additional Notes: 장시간 플레이와 Steam Overlay 사용을 위해 8GB RAM 이상을 권장합니다.
